title: Bonfyre Layer-Aware Artifact and Recipe Target Schema
description: Defines sub-model artifact types and recipe target extensions for layer-aware Bonfyre transforms. This is Phase 1 of the layer-aware infrastructure — inspect + pull + pack. Phase 2 adds pull execution; Phase 3 adds composition routing.

layer_fragment.description: A contiguous range of ONNX nodes extracted from a parent model.

source_model.description: Path or bonfyre model ID of parent model

fpq_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .fpq compressed file; filled by finalize_artifact.py

transform_fragment.description: A packed transform composed of multiple layer fragments. Output of bonfyre-layer pack-transform.

source_parts.description: Source .onnx paths used as input to pack

recipe_target_schema.description: Extension to bonfyre-run recipe stage args. Stages that reference sub-model artifacts use a 'target' block alongside 'model'.

full_model.description: Standard full-model reference. Existing behavior; no changes needed.

layer_range.description: Pull and use nodes START:END of a model as input to a stage.

head.description: Pull nodes matching a name prefix (classifier head, projection, etc.)

packed_transform.description: Use a pre-packed transform fragment (output of bonfyre-layer pack-transform). Suitable for composed multi-family artifacts.

scope: bonfyre-model register layer_fragment artifacts (fpq_sha256, pull, verify)
bonfyre-run stage: pull-layer inside DAG (auto-pull from hf:// source)
FPQ compression for layer fragments (bonfyre-compress pack on .onnx fragment)
bonfyre-layer compose: route between transform fragments based on data geometry
geometry-aware routing: T04+T15 global, T16 long-form — encoded in recipe target
FPQx: alignment layer across model families for mixed-layer composition
SLI: execution over composed compressed layer graphs
E8: stability geometry for mixed-layer composition
